title: Направо и налево в одну дорогу
adaptation: Signalised junction: south and north green, east and west red. Red hatch from the south turns right into the eastbound lane; blue SUV from the north turns left into the same lane. Blue yields to the oncoming right-turner and starts after red has completed its turn and moved on.
